title: Silent Reconnaissance
story: Black Falcon Bank has received no confirmed intrusion alert, but the SOC suspects that an external actor may be mapping internal-facing services. Normal user traffic, monitoring probes and authorized vulnerability assessments are occurring at the same time. Determine whether hostile reconnaissance is present.
objective: Perform a network threat hunt across mixed telemetry and identify suspicious reconnaissance activity without relying on a single alert source.

questions.label: Identify the hostile reconnaissance source IP
Identify the first hostile activity time
